title: How AI Interpretation Closes Healthcare Language Gaps
summary: Learn how AI medical interpretation closes healthcare language gaps across pre-visit care, clinical encounters, inpatient care, discharge.
body_markdown:
###


AI medical interpretation provides real-time spoken interpretation between patients and healthcare professionals during clinical communication.


###


It can make spoken-language support available across pre-visit communication, clinical encounters, inpatient care, discharge, telehealth, patient calls, and follow-up.


###


No. AI medical interpretation supports live spoken communication. Medical translation usually refers to written content such as forms, instructions, records, or patient materials.


###


Yes. It can support registration, patient calls, telehealth, bedside care, discharge teaching, and other healthcare workflows where real-time spoken communication is needed.


###


Track time to active interpretation, language support at high-value decisions, patient understanding, repeated clarification, safety events, ad hoc interpreter use, and follow-up completion.
